description: Domains about to be released, with a value score. Returns a list of records; pass next_cursor to get the next page. Fields: domain (varchar); tld (varchar); release_at (date): Day it can be registered again (from 04:00 UTC), unless renewed first; days_left (integer); length (integer): Characters before the dot; score (integer): 0-100; higher is shorter, cleaner and closer to real words; word_sv (boolean); word_en (boolean); compound (boolean); possible_trademark (boolean): Contains a well-known brand: probably not usable; reasons_sv (varchar): Why, in Swedish; reasons_en (varchar): Why, in English.
